grammar:
# SecEdge decision-only schema — the critical path of the Iteration 3 cascade.
#
# The full schema (secedge.gbnf) orders the fields
#     label · confidence · rationale · action · action_rationale
# so reaching `action` requires generating the whole rationale first. Section
# 5.6.1 identifies exactly that as the dominant latency term: "the
# rationale-generation stage dominates the latency budget".
#
# But the action is not information the model has to produce. Section 3.6.5
# defines a deterministic per-class action policy — each label maps to one fixed
# action — and the policy module already overrides the emitted value whenever
# confidence falls below the 0.50 floor. The action is therefore a pure function
# of (label, confidence), both of which the schema places FIRST.
#
# This grammar stops after confidence. It yields the complete decision — label,
# confidence, and hence action by table lookup — in roughly a dozen tokens
# instead of the ~150 the full schema needs. The rationale is not discarded: it
# is generated by a second, off-critical-path call for the audit record, which
# is where Section 4.4.2.3 says retrieval grounding belongs in the first place.
#
# Under greedy decoding the label emitted here is identical to the label the
# full grammar emits, because the two share their prefix up to this point and
# the constraint at the label position is the same in both.

# NOTE on whitespace: `ws` is bounded to a single optional space, matching the
# instruction-tuning corpus exactly. An unbounded whitespace class here is a
# trap: at
# the position before the closing brace the model prefers a newline, and with
# greedy decoding it emits newlines until the token limit instead of closing the
# object. That yields unparseable output and, on the decision schema, silently
# destroys the result.

root ::= "{" ws "\"label\":" ws label ws "," ws "\"confidence\":" ws confidence ws "}"

label ::= "\"Normal\"" | "\"DDoS_TCP\"" | "\"DDoS_UDP\"" | "\"DDoS_ICMP\"" | "\"DDoS_HTTP\"" | "\"SQL_injection\"" | "\"Password\"" | "\"Vulnerability_scanner\"" | "\"Uploading\"" | "\"Backdoor\"" | "\"Port_Scanning\"" | "\"XSS\"" | "\"Ransomware\"" | "\"MITM\"" | "\"Fingerprinting\""

confidence ::= "0" | "1" | "0." [0-9] [0-9]? [0-9]?

ws ::= " "?
